---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for ProveIt
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting.

## Motivation / Use Case

What problem does this solve? Who benefits?

Describe specific scenarios where this feature would be useful. Concrete examples are more persuasive than abstract benefits.

## Proposed Solution

How do you envision this working?

If you have specific API or interface ideas:

```rust
// Example of how the feature might be used
```

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposal better?

This is a good place to discuss tradeoffs.

## Impact Assessment

### Accessibility Impact

How does this feature affect accessibility?

- [ ] Improves accessibility
- [ ] Neutral — no accessibility impact
- [ ] Requires careful design to maintain accessibility
- [ ] **Concern**: might harm accessibility

If the feature has accessibility implications, please describe:
- How will screen reader users interact with it?
- Is keyboard navigation supported?
- Are there alternative modalities (audio, haptic)?
- Does it rely on any single channel (color, vision, hearing)?

### Mathematical Implications

If this affects formal methods or verification:

- [ ] Pure UI/UX — no mathematical impact
- [ ] Improves existing formal methods
- [ ] Adds new formal methods
- [ ] Affects verification soundness — **needs careful review**

### Performance Impact

- [ ] Negligible
- [ ] Improves performance
- [ ] Some performance cost, justified
- [ ] Significant performance implications

### Scope

How large is this feature?

- [ ] Small — could be done in a single PR
- [ ] Medium — multiple related PRs
- [ ] Large — major undertaking, may need an RFC

## Examples from Other Tools

Are there similar features in other tools (Coq, Lean, Agda, Isabelle, etc.)?

How does the proposed approach compare?

## Mathematical Background

If this feature relates to specific mathematical concepts, briefly explain:

- The mathematical theory involved
- Relevant references (papers, books)
- How this fits into existing formal methods

## Mockups / Examples

If you have visual designs, examples, or mockups:

- Include them with **text descriptions** for accessibility
- Show typical use cases
- Indicate user interactions

## Open Questions

What aspects need further design discussion?

- [ ] API design
- [ ] User interface
- [ ] Implementation strategy
- [ ] Integration with existing features
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Accessibility approach

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'd like to implement this myself
- [ ] I can help with design but not implementation
- [ ] I can help with testing and feedback
- [ ] I'm just suggesting; someone else would implement

## Additional Context

Anything else that would help maintainers and contributors understand the request.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] I have considered accessibility implications
- [ ] I have provided concrete use cases
- [ ] I have indicated the scope of the feature
